kinds.extract: Structured extraction from a fixed document given in the prompt (no tools).
kinds.code-review: Review of one public source file pinned at a commit SHA (one fetch, then analysis).
kinds.research: Answer a question from a pinned public standard, with the quote that supports it (one fetch, then analysis).
kinds.multi-step: Fetch two pinned sources and compare them (two fetches, then a computed answer).

method.redo: Each task ran as a hosted Proofable job under the org Benchmarker; durationMs, tokens and model calls are the job runtime's own record. Redo dollars are those tokens at the model's dated list price (prices below). Hosted runtime and sandbox charges are not included.
method.checkOffline: verifyPortableProofEnvelope from @proofable/sdk on the signed envelope, n=10 per receipt, median, on one machine (prices.check.machine). No network, no account, 0 model tokens.
method.checkReadVerify: Anonymous exact-id read of the disclosed receipt (GET /api/v1/proofs/<qHash>?includePortableProof=1, no account), n=5 per receipt, median, plus the offline verify median. 0 model tokens.
method.checkUsd: Compute only: ms x 1 GB x $0.0000166667/GB-s + $2e-7 per request (AWS Lambda x86 on-demand: $0.0000166667 per GB-second, $0.20 per 1M requests, billed per 1 ms (https://aws.amazon.com/lambda/pricing/, read 2026-11-16)). Model tokens 0.
method.selection: Planned: 15 tasks x 3 models x k=3. Hosted Default (GLM-5.3 Flash head) took 55-72 s on extraction and 11 to 50+ minutes on fetch-and-review tasks (about 15,000 to 18,000 reasoning tokens at roughly 20 tokens a second); one run was cancelled at 40 minutes. A full k=3 Default matrix could not finish inside the run window and would only have raised every ratio, so the headline uses the two models with the complete matrix (hosted Advanced, Gemini 3.8 Flash: 15 tasks x k=3 each = 90 jobs). Default rows are in allModels and byModelAll.
method.acceptance: runtimeAccepted is 0 of N because the acceptance criterion was written as a sentence ("The answer addresses every part of the request and mentions X") and text-mode acceptance looks for that text in the answer. It says nothing about the answers. onTask is the code-graded check: the answer contains the pinned key fact for its task. Neither is an accuracy claim; this run measures the cost of redoing finished work against checking its receipt.
method.readPacing: The API slows one client down past half its per-minute limit (+100 ms per extra request, up to 5 s). The first read pass went back to back (about 90 a minute from one address) and measured that slowdown (anonymousReadMsUnpacedMedian). anonymousReadMsMedian is the paced pass: n=5 per receipt, one request every 1.6 s, the rate one checker reads at.
method.ratios: Per job: redo durationMs / check ms and redo dollars / check dollars; aggregates are median and p10/p90 across jobs. Only completed jobs whose receipt verified offline are in the aggregates.

prices.note: List prices, not billed cost. Hosted rows are the provider list prices Proofable records for its hosted models (protocol src/config/inference-model-credit-weights.js, INFERENCE_PROVIDER_LIST_PRICES); the Gemini row is Google's paid-tier Standard price read on the retrieval date. Cache-write premiums are not applied.
